notes: Tell me anything: at the bottom of Today is a box where you type or say anything, and an AI assistant files it in your notes repo: a dated reminder into your reminder list, an idea with your ideas, a fact into its topic's file, and anything else into the inbox folder. Ask it a question and it answers from your notes. Each change it makes is saved as a change of its own and listed under its reply with Undo. Pick the model (Haiku, Sonnet, or Opus) and how deeply it thinks; your pick is kept. It works through your own AI gateway: add its key in Settings, Assistant. Your repo's ASSISTANT.md says where things go. Also fixed: the microphone is asked for before any recording, so a mic button can no longer close the app.
